A relentlessly entertaining night at the theatre, the show has a sleek and captivating staging with an extremely strong ensemble of actors. Lorna Courtney and Ben Jackson Walker are easily stars in the making, Melanie la Barrie proves to be an extremely wise transferring decision, and Paulo Szot's performance is perfect to a degree beyond human expression.
